ex.s: When faced with such a fence, Chesterton thinks the fact that we can’t see the point of the fence is why we should not tear it down.
ex.t: 当面对这样一道栅栏时，切斯特顿认为，我们看不出这道栅栏的意义这一事实，正是我们不应将其拆除的原因。

ex.s: Maybe that feeling comes from growing up in South Africa, where the phrase “there are children starving in Africa” was more of an uncomfortable reminder of fact than a prayer at dinner time.
ex.t: 也许那种感觉源于在南非长大，在那里，“非洲有儿童在挨饿”这句话与其说是一句餐前祈祷，不如说是对现实令人不安的提醒。

ex.s: Perhaps most   47  , however, was the fact that this man spent hours studying every day after hard physical labor.
ex.t: 然而，或许最____47____的，是这个男人在繁重体力劳动后每天还花数小时学习这一事实。

ex.s: This effect capitalizes on the fact that when people make errors, those errors aren’t always the same.
ex.t: 这种效应利用了这样一个事实：当人们犯错时，这些错误并不总是相同的。

ex.s: Talking about food encouraged her parents to finally open up about their past, like the fact that her father had owned a Chinatown restaurant in the 1940s.
ex.t: 聊到食物让她的父母终于敞开心扉谈起过去，比如她父亲在20世纪40年代曾拥有一家唐人街餐馆这一事实。

ex.s: This variety, coupled with the fact that tiny forests grow up to ten times faster than standard forests, means they attract a rich abundance of wildlife.
ex.t: 这种多样性，加上微型森林的生长速度比标准森林快多达十倍这一事实，意味着它们吸引了丰富的野生动物。

ex.s: About 98 cents of every duck stamp dollar goes directly into the Migratory Bird Conservation Fund to purchase wetlands and wildlife habitat for inclusion into the National Wildlife Refuge System — a fact that ensures this land will be protected and available for all generations to come.
ex.t: 每枚鸭票中约98美分直接进入候鸟保护基金，用于购买湿地和野生动物栖息地，以纳入国家野生动物保护区系统——这一事实确保了这片土地将受到保护，并可供子孙后代使用。

ex.s: Housewarming parties get their name from the fact that a long time ago people would actually bring firewood to a new home as a gift.
ex.t: 暖房派对得名于这样一个事实：很久以前，人们会真的带上柴火作为礼物送到新家。

ex.s: It wasn't the fact that he'd won; it was more than that.
ex.t: 重要的不是他赢了这一事实；其意义远不止于此。

ex.s: But Smith was struck mainly by the fact that she didn't truly grasp any of the skills the author described.
ex.t: 但史密斯主要被这样一个事实触动：她并没有真正掌握作者所描述的任何技能。

ex.s: But all of today's excited discussion about these possibilities presupposes the fact that we will be able to build these systems.
ex.t: 但今天所有关于这些可能性的热烈讨论，都预设了我们将能够建造这些系统这一事实。

ex.s: One was that I was amazing at the fact that a sick person could feel much more better after seeing a doctor.
ex.t: 其中一点是，令我惊讶的是，一个病人看完医生后竟能感觉好得多这一事实。

ex.s: The friendship that grew out of the experience of making that film and The Sting four years later had its root in the fact that although there was an age difference, we both came from a tradition of theater and live TV.
ex.t: 这段友谊源于拍摄那部电影的经历，以及四年后拍摄《骗中骗》的经历，其根源在于这样一个事实：尽管我们有年龄差距，但我们都有着戏剧和电视直播的传统。

ex.s: The friendship that grew out of the experience of making that film and The Sting four years later had its root in the fact that although there was an age difference, we both came from a tradition of theater and live TV.
ex.t: 这段友谊源于拍摄那部电影的经历，以及四年后拍摄《骗中骗》的经历，其根源在于这样一个事实：尽管我们有年龄差距，但我们都有着戏剧和电视直播的传统。

ex.s: For the machine, this quality is not in-born, nor is it something introduced by humans; it is a logical consequence of the simple fact that the machine cannot achieve its original purpose if it is dead.
ex.t: 对机器而言，这种品质不是天生的，也不是人类赋予的；它是这样一个简单事实的逻辑结果：如果机器停止运转，它就无法实现其原本的目的。

ex.s: The most rewarding day for our group was project day，when all the efforts we put into collecting the items finally came together．When I saw the various supplies we had collected，it hit me that every kit we were to build that day would eventually be in the hands of an Iraqi child．Over the past four months，I had never imagined how I would feel once our project was completed．While making the kits，I realized that I had lost sight of the true meaning behind it．I had only focused on the fact that it was another school project and one I wanted to get a good grade on．When the kits were completed，and ready to be sent overseas，the warm feeling I had was one I would never forget．
ex.t: 对我们小组来说，最有收获的一天是项目日，我们为收集物品所付出的所有努力终于汇集在一起。当我看到我们收集到的各种物资时，我突然意识到，那天我们要组装的每个工具包最终都会来到一个伊拉克儿童手中。在过去的四个月里，我从未想象过项目完成后自己会有怎样的感受。在制作工具包时，我意识到自己已经忽视了背后的真正意义。我只关注这样一个事实：这不过是又一个学校项目，而我想拿个好成绩。当工具包完成、准备送往海外时，我心中的那种温暖感觉是我永远不会忘记的。

defs.def: a thing that is known to be true, especially when it can be proved （可证实的）事实，真相

ex.s: Whether facts speak louder than words.
ex.t: 事实是否胜于雄辩。

ex.s: To present a fact.
ex.t: 陈述一个事实。

ex.s: It is a well-known fact, especially in my school, that Junior year is the time of packing many AP classes into the schedule.
ex.t: 这是一个众所周知的事实，尤其是在我的学校里，高三那年是把许多AP课程塞进课表的时候。

defs.def: things that are true rather than things that have been invented 真实的事物；真实情况

ex.s: Dutch authors Thalia Verkade and Marco te Brömmelstroet are bothered by facts like these.
ex.t: 荷兰作家塔利亚·维尔卡德和马尔科·特·布鲁默尔斯特劳特被诸如此类的事实所困扰。

ex.s: Research has found that learning obtained from a well-told story is remembered more accurately, and for far longer, than from facts and figures.
ex.t: 研究发现，从一个讲述精彩的故事中学到的东西，比从事实和数据中学到的记得更准确，也持久得多。

ex.s: Facts and figures.
ex.t: 事实与数据。

ex.s: Why does storytelling work better than mere statement of facts in promoting learning?
ex.t: 为什么讲故事比单纯陈述事实更能促进学习？

ex.s: If you decide that you need to read the whole book, decide how much you can read at a time. ____19____ A history book which may contain the facts in story form will be easier to read than one dealing with scientific subjects.
ex.t: 如果你决定需要读完整本书，先决定一次能读多少。____19____一本以故事形式包含事实的历史书，会比讲科学主题的书更容易读。

ex.s: Always keep a pencil and paper beside you. ____20____Note also the facts important for your purpose as well as anything which leads you to further research.
ex.t: 始终在身边放一支铅笔和一张纸。____20____同时记下对你的目的重要的事实，以及任何引导你进一步研究的内容。

ex.s: Give two of the facts, (no more than 15 words)
ex.t: 给出其中两个事实（不超过15个词）。

ex.s: Explore the monuments and memorials on the National Mall as your guide shares unique facts and history at each stop.
ex.t: 当导游在每一站分享独特的事实和历史时，探索国家广场上的纪念碑和纪念物。

ex.s: Frequent stops are made for photo taking as your guide offers unique facts and history.
ex.t: 导游会频繁停车拍照，并讲解独特的事实和历史。

ex.s: But they usually have some elements in common: rather than a list of dry facts, stories have plots and they introduce characters.
ex.t: 但它们通常有一些共同之处：故事不是干巴巴的事实罗列，而是有情节，并且会引入人物。

ex.s: Most of my reading through primary， middle and high school was factual reading． I read for knowledge， and to make A's on my tests． Occasionally， I would read a novel that was assigned， but I didn't enjoy this type of reading． I liked facts， things that are concrete． I thought anything abstract left too much room for argument．
ex.t: 从小学到中学，我大多数的阅读都是事实性阅读。我为了获取知识而读，也为了在考试中拿A。偶尔我会读老师布置的小说，但我不喜欢这类阅读。我喜欢事实，喜欢具体的事物。我觉得任何抽象的东西都留给争论太多空间。

ex.s: As you listen, make notes of key information such as names, numbers, facts and instructions.
ex.t: 听的时候，把关键信息记下来，比如姓名、数字、事实和指示。

defs.def: （用以强调，尤其与刚提到的相反）事实上，实际上

ex.s: Quitting is in fact necessary for growth.
ex.t: 事实上，放弃对成长是必要的。

ex.s: “In fact, we may be helping increase the moisture downwind by creating wetter ground.”
ex.t: 事实上，我们可能正在通过制造更湿润的地面来帮助增加下风向的湿度。

ex.s: In fact, don’t wait until you’ve made a mistake to try this — it’s a great way to boost self-confidence at any time.
ex.t: 事实上，不要等到犯了错误才去尝试——这在任何时候都是增强自信的好方法。

ex.s: It is encouraging to discover that by readily accepting our errors and wisely placing ourselves in the way of being wrong, we can in fact overcome weaknesses and rise stronger.
ex.t: 令人鼓舞的是，我们发现，通过欣然接受错误并明智地让自己处于可能犯错的位置，我们事实上能够克服弱点，并变得更强。

ex.s: In fact, universities often shift emphasis from teaching to other ranking factors.
ex.t: 事实上，大学经常将重心从教学转移到其他排名因素上。

ex.s: In fact, Royte writes, “if food waste were a country, it would be the third largest producer of greenhouse gases in the world.”
ex.t: 事实上，Royte写道，“如果食物浪费是一个国家，它将是世界上第三大温室气体排放国。”

ex.s: In fact, children consider this method _40_ when others use it.
ex.t: 事实上，当别人使用这种方法时，孩子们认为它____40____。

ex.s: In fact, the methods of science have varied between disciplines and across time.
ex.t: 事实上，科学的方法因学科和时代而不同。

ex.s: In fact plenty of younger kids have one in their pocket.
ex.t: 事实上，很多年纪更小的孩子口袋里就有一部。

ex.s: In fact, most people only absorb about 20 percent of a speaker’s message.
ex.t: 事实上，大多数人只吸收了说话者信息的约20%。

ex.s: In fact, anyone wishing to try race walking should probably first consult a coach or experienced racer to learn proper technique, she says.
ex.t: 事实上，她说，任何想尝试竞走的人可能都应该先咨询教练或有经验的竞走者，以学习正确的技术。

ex.s: In fact, Hollywood has been hot on live animals lately.
ex.t: 事实上，好莱坞最近对活体动物很热衷。

ex.s: Jenn Berman, author of The A to Z Guide to Raising Happy and Confident Kids, says, "We've gone to the opposite extreme of a few decades ago when parents tended to be more strict." By giving kids a lot of praise, parents think they're building their children's confidence, when, in fact, it may be just the opposite.
ex.t: 《养育快乐自信孩子的A到Z指南》一书的作者珍·贝尔曼说：“我们已经走到了几十年前父母往往更严厉的相反极端。通过给孩子很多表扬，父母以为自己在建立孩子的自信，而事实上，结果可能恰恰相反。”

ex.s: Most of us， in fact， progressively narrow the variety of our lives． We succeed in our field of specialization and then become trapped in it． Nothing surprises us． We lose our sense of wonder． But， if we are willing to learn， the opportunities are everywhere．
ex.t: 事实上，我们大多数人都逐渐缩小了生活的多样性。我们在自己的专业领域取得成功，然后被困在其中。没有什么能让我们感到惊讶。我们失去了好奇心。但是，如果我们愿意学习，机会无处不在。

ex.s: (In fact, it still is common among many online local networks, like the Buy Nothing Project.).
ex.t: （事实上，它在许多线上本地网络中仍然很常见，比如“不买东西”项目。）

ex.s: In fact, in an interview, an important question to ask is: “ What would be expected of me as an employee?” In today's tough 'job market, young job seekers need to provide a potential employer with good reasons to hire them.
ex.t: 事实上，在面试中，一个重要的提问是：“作为员工，我被期望做什么？”在当今严峻的就业市场上，年轻的求职者需要向潜在雇主提供雇佣他们的充分理由。

ex.s: In fact, I got the same medal as the one that the guy who came in first place had.
ex.t: 事实上，我得到的奖牌和得第一名的那个人得到的一模一样。

ex.s: In fact, the key to easy morning wake-up lies in resting your body clock   36     Here is how to make one.
ex.t: 事实上，轻松早晨醒来的关键在于让你的生物钟得到休息____36____。以下是如何做到的方法。

ex.s: In fact, tradition also refers to the things that have been developing and that are still being created,” he said.
ex.t: 事实上，传统也指那些一直在发展、并且仍在被创造的事物，”他说。

ex.s: In fact, we stayed at the same campsite as we did ten years ago.
ex.t: 事实上，我们住在了和十年前同一个露营地。

ex.s: In fact, we ended up laughing and ate them all.
ex.t: 事实上，我们最后笑着把它们全吃光了。

ex.s: In fact, good friends can share up to 1% of the same genes - as much as we might share with our great-great-great grandparents!
ex.t: 事实上，好朋友可以共享多达1%的相同基因——就像我们可能与我们的高祖父（曾曾曾祖父）共享的一样多！

ex.s: In fact, the last time there were pandas in the Netherlands was in 1987.
ex.t: 事实上，荷兰上一次有大熊猫是在1987年。
